goal: Growth-biased hybrid block: rebuild strength, gain size, maintain aerobic fitness, and reintroduce controlled explosiveness. Size remains primary; secondary running targets: sub-19:00 5K on 2026-08-22; 1:35 half marathon on 2026-11-22.

days.title: Plyometrics + Functional Power
description: Warm-up jog: 10 min easy plus skips, ankling, hip openers, and 3 relaxed strides.
Progression: add power volume only when jumps stay crisp and knees stay quiet the next day; sprint RPE 7-8.
Plyometrics: pogos 3 x 20 sec, low broad jumps 4 x 2, and med-ball slams 4 x 5 at crisp RPE 6-7 if available.
Hill sprint technique: 4-6 x 8-10 sec at sprint RPE 7-8.
Functional work: sled push if easy to set up or farmer carries 4 x 30 m at RPE 7.
Core: side plank 2 x 30 sec per side or Pallof press 3 x 10 per side.

days.title: Aerobic Base + Reset
description: Easy run RPE 3-4: 9 km conversational; shorten to 6 km if sleep or knees are poor.
Optional: 4 x 20 sec relaxed strides at RPE 6 only if the week felt easy.
Recovery: long mobility reset for calves, quads, hips, and feet.
Fueling: carbs before and after; keep this aerobic, not competitive.

days.title: Upper Strength + Calisthenics Pull
description: Warm-up: 5-7 min easy bike, band pull-aparts, scap push-ups, and 2 bench ramp sets.
Progression: double progression; add load only after all sets reach the top of the range at RPE 8 or lower, about 2 RIR.
Bench press: top set 1 x 4-6 at RPE 8, then 2 back-off sets x 5-7 at RPE 7-8.
Pull-ups: 4 x 4-8 at RPE 8 paired with chest-supported row 4 x 8-12 at RPE 8.
Overhead press or Arnold press: 3 x 6-10 at RPE 8 paired with incline dumbbell press or dumbbell press 2 x 8-10 at RPE 8.
Shoulder and arm finisher: lateral raises 3 x 12-20 at RPE 8 plus farmer carries 4 x 30-40 m, preacher curls or hammer curls 2 x 10-15, and reverse curls 2 x 12-15.

days.title: Lower Strength + Knee Capacity
description: Warm-up: 7-8 min bike, ankle rocks, bodyweight squats, and short-foot activation.
Progression: double progression; add load only when knee tracking stays clean, discomfort stays 0-2/10, and top sets stay near RPE 8.
Hack squat or goblet squat: top set 1 x 6-8 at RPE 8, then 2 back-off sets x 8-10 at RPE 7-8.
Romanian deadlift: 3 x 6-8 at RPE 7-8 with controlled eccentrics.
Leg extension: 3 x 12-15 at RPE 8 paired with front-foot elevated split squat 2-3 x 8-10 per leg at RPE 7.
Core finisher: seated calf raise plus tibialis raises 4 x 12-20 each at RPE 7, then side plank 2 x 30 sec.

days.title: Recovery + Easy Zone 2
description: Easy run RPE 3-4: 5 km at conversational effort; cadence light and relaxed.
Mobility: 8-10 min hips, quads, calves, and ankles.
Optional: 20-30 min walk later if knees feel normal.
Fueling: fruit or rye bread plus caffeine is enough before a short morning run.

days.title: Upper Calisthenics + Shoulder Hypertrophy
description: Warm-up: 5 min easy cardio, shoulder prep, light cable rows, and scap pull-ups.
Progression: double progression; beat total quality reps before adding load or a set, keeping most work at RPE 8-9.
Pull-ups: 5 x 4-8 or 20-30 total quality reps at RPE 8.
Dips or push-ups: 3 x 8-15 at RPE 8-9 paired with one-arm dumbbell row or cable row 3 x 8-12 at RPE 8.
Shoulder and chest block: incline dumbbell press 2-3 x 8-12 at RPE 8 plus pec-deck 2 x 10-15, lateral raises 3 x 15-20, and rear delt fly 2 x 15-20.
Arm and core finisher: tricep pulldown 2 x 10-15 plus hanging leg raises 2-3 sets at RPE 8.

days.title: Legs + Delts Accessory
description: Warm-up: 5-6 min easy bike, ankle rocks, band pull-aparts, and one ramp set for each pairing.
Progression: keep this short and low-fatigue; stop 1-2 reps before failure and leave fresher than you arrived.
Leg extension: 3 x 12-18 at RPE 8 paired with seated or lying hamstring curl 3 x 10-15 at RPE 8.
Seated calf raise: 3 x 10-15 at RPE 8 paired with lateral raises 3 x 15-25 at RPE 8.
Rear delt fly or reverse pec-deck: 2-3 x 15-20 at RPE 8; if time is tight, complete the first 3 exercises and leave.

Chest/back/core top-up: push-ups 2 x clean reps, dips 2 x 6-10, cable row 2 x 10-12, face pulls 2 x 12-15, Pallof press 3 x 10 per side, plank variations 2 x 30-45 sec, kettlebell side bend 2 x 10-12, around the head kettlebell 2 x 8 each way, and weighted sit-ups 2 x 8-12.

days.title: Plyometrics + Hill Sprint Technique
description: Warm-up jog: 10-12 min easy plus leg swings, A-skips, ankling, and 3 relaxed strides.
Progression: add sprint reps only when contacts stay snappy and knees stay quiet the next day; sprint RPE 7-8, never max.
Plyometrics: pogos 3 x 20 sec, snap-downs 3 x 5, low broad jumps 3 x 3 at crisp RPE 6-7.
Hill sprints: 4 x 10-12 sec uphill at sprint RPE 7-8; full walk-back recovery.
Stop the sprint set if mechanics get sloppy or knees feel sharp.
Optional: weighted sit-ups 2 x 8-12 and side plank 2 x 30 sec per side.

days.title: Easy Longer Aerobic Run
description: Easy run RPE 3-4: 10 km at conversational effort; keep the final 2 km controlled, not fast.
Mobility: calves, quads, hip flexors, and gentle knee-friendly range work.
Recovery: protein plus a large carb meal within 2 hours.
Fueling: eat carbs the night before and before the run; add electrolytes if warm.

days.title: Full-Body Athletic Strength
description: Warm-up: 7 min easy cardio, squat-to-stand, band pull-aparts, push-ups, and hinge ramp sets.
Progression: double progression; add load only when presses, hinges, and pulls are all stable at RPE 8 or lower.
Incline press, shoulder press, or bench press: top set 1 x 6-8 at RPE 8, then 2-3 back-off sets x 8-10 at RPE 7-8.
Trap-bar deadlift or Romanian deadlift: 2-3 x 5-6 at RPE 7-8, leave 2-3 RIR.
Pull-ups or chest-supported rows: 4 x 6-10 at RPE 8 paired with front-foot elevated split squat or hack squat 3 x 8-10 per leg at RPE 8.
Shoulder, trap, and quad finisher: lateral raises 2-3 x 15-20, dumbbell trap raise 2 x 12-15, leg extension 2 x 12-15, then weighted sit-ups 2 x 8-12.
Activation: light good mornings: 2 x 12-15 at RPE 5-6 using no more than 50% of normal working load; stop if symptoms rise or the next morning is worse.

days.title: Easy Run + Relaxed Strides
description: Easy run RPE 3-4: 6 km conversational.
Strides: 4 x 15 sec relaxed at RPE 6 on flat ground only if knees feel normal.
Mobility: 8 min calves, quads, glutes, and ankles.
Fueling: small carb snack before morning running if sleep was poor.

days.title: Lower Hypertrophy + Posterior Chain
description: Warm-up: 7-8 min bike, split squat isometric holds, ankle rocks, and hinge ramp sets.
Progression: double progression; add load only when tempo and knee control stay stable at RPE 8 or lower.
Bulgarian split squat or front-foot elevated split squat: 4 x 8-10 per leg at RPE 7-8.
Romanian deadlift: 3 x 8 at RPE 7-8 paired with leg press or hack squat 3 x 10-15 at RPE 8.
Walking lunges with dumbbells: 2-3 x 12 steps per leg at RPE 7 paired with reverse Nordic curls 2 x 6-10 at RPE 7 and leg extension 2 x 15-20 at RPE 8.
Core finisher: calf raises plus Copenhagen plank 2-3 sets each at RPE 7.
Activation: weighted hyperextensions: 2 x 10-15 at RPE 5-6 using no more than 50% of normal working load; stop if symptoms rise or the next morning is worse.

days.title: Upper Hypertrophy + Shoulders / Upper Back
description: Warm-up: 5 min easy cardio, shoulder prep, light rows, and thoracic mobility.
Progression: double progression; add reps before load and keep the whole session capped around RPE 8.
Chest-supported row, cable row, Pendlay row, or barbell row: 4 x 8-12 at RPE 8 paired with dumbbell or machine shoulder press 3 x 8-10 at RPE 8.
Lat pull-down or pull-ups: 3 x 8-12 at RPE 8 paired with incline dumbbell press 2-3 x 8-12 at RPE 8.
Shoulder and upper back finisher: lateral raises 3 x 15-20, rear delt fly or reverse pec-deck 3 x 15-20, face pulls 2 x 12-15, and dumbbell rotator cuff work.
Easy run RPE 3-4: 3-4 km conversational only if legs feel normal; otherwise walk 20-30 min.

days.title: Core + Chest/Back Strength Capacity
description: Warm-up: 5 min easy bike, shoulder prep, thoracic mobility, hip openers, and two light press/row ramp sets.
Progression: this is the eighth strength day in the 14-day wave; cap work at RPE 7-8, use supersets, and trim accessories before anchor work if recovery dips.
Chest volume: bench press 3 x 6-8, incline dumbbell press 3 x 8-10, dumbbell press 2 x 8-10, pec-deck 2 x 12-15, dips 2 x 6-10, and push-ups 2 x clean reps.
Back volume: lat pulldown or pull-ups 3 x 8-12, cable row or chest-supported row 3 x 8-12, face pulls 2 x 12-15, and rear delt fly or reverse pec-deck 2 x 15-20.
Leg maintenance: hip thrust or glute bridge 3 x 8-12, leg extension 2 x 12-15, and seated or lying hamstring curl 2 x 10-15 at RPE 7.

Core volume: Pallof press 3 x 10 per side, side plank 2 x 30 sec per side, plank variations 2 x 30-45 sec, hanging leg raises 2-3 sets, weighted sit-ups 2 x 8-12, and kettlebell side bend or around the head kettlebell 2 x 10.
